name: GlassMentionList
material_impl: Shared OptimizedGlass elevation=level2 plus utility class 'border border-white/15' (raw Tailwind-style white border mixed with glass-* utilities). No bespoke blur. Screenshot: 99% of pixels >= 233 luminance, list reads as faint white card on white canvas.
a11y: Plain <ul>/<button> list. No role=listbox/option, no aria-activedescendant, no Arrow-key navigation, no Enter/Escape handling: it cannot function as an @-mention autocomplete when focus stays in a text editor. Buttons lack type='button' (submits forms). Empty-state li is fine.
api: Function component, no forwardRef, no style/...rest passthrough, only className. items typed but mapped as 'any' (L39). onSelect only passes id. No highlighted/active index prop, no renderItem, no loading state.
fake_complexity: None; trivially simple. But the name implies a mention autocomplete and it has none of the required keyboard/anchoring behaviour.
target: GlassCombobox / a shared Listbox primitive (role=listbox + roving focus) exposed as a MentionMenu recipe
justification: A 60-line styled <ul> of buttons is not a mention component: no listbox semantics, no keyboard model, no anchoring to the caret. The library already has listbox-like components (Combobox, CommandPalette). Fold it into a shared Listbox primitive and ship mention as a documented recipe on that primitive rather than a separate root export.

name: GlassMessageList
material_impl: GlassCard shell + glass-surface-* utilities; status dots use raw Tailwind palette bg-green-400/bg-yellow-400/bg-red-400/bg-gray-400 (L355-361), selection uses bg-primary/20 and ring-primary (non glass-prefixed). Mixed token systems.
motion: Motion preset fadeIn wrapper (not reduced-motion gated at this call site), per-row animate-slide-in-up gated by useReducedMotion (L300). scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) on every messages change ignores reduced-motion (L134-141) and scrolls the whole page when embedded.
a11y: role=log + aria-label on card is good. Message rows are clickable <div>s with no tabIndex/role/keyboard handler (L296-309). Hover-only action rail (opacity-0 group-hover) is invisible to keyboard and touch (L480). Icon-only Heart/Reply/More buttons have no aria-label (L483-517). Heart icon sends a thumbs-up emoji (L488). Search input has no label.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. Spreads ...props onto GlassCard. virtualScroll prop declared and destructured but never used (L59, L111). Overlapping density knobs: compact, preview, density='compact', contained all alias each other (L210-211). Status always renders Check+CheckCheck regardless of message state (L528-531) - read receipts are fake.
ssr: 'use client'; formatTimestamp uses new Date() during render -> hydration mismatch risk for relative times ('5m') between server and client.
fake_complexity: Partial: 'virtualScroll' is a no-op; message status indicator is hard-coded double check; More button is a no-op (L513).
target: Merge with GlassChat into a single chat kit (MessageList + MessageBubble + Composer) built on GlassVirtualList
justification: Chat is a legitimate premium showcase surface, but this implementation is a hover-only, mouse-only list with dead props (virtualScroll), fake read receipts, raw Tailwind status colours and page-scrolling auto-scroll. It overlaps GlassChat. Redesign as one chat kit with real bubble styling, keyboard-reachable actions, a true status model and virtualization.

name: GlassMindMap (+ useMindMap)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell, but all SVG node/edge colours are hard-coded rgba (node fill rgba(14,25,46,0.86), stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.22), selection rgba(109,211,255,0.72), edges rgba(255,255,255,0.28)) at L310, L383-386, L582. Dark-only palette with no light theme mapping. Toolbar 'buttons' are OptimizedGlass divs.
motion: No transitions. Zoom/pan via CSS transform. No reduced-motion relevance.
a11y: Nodes are <g> with onClick/onDoubleClick only; no tabIndex, role, aria-label, or keyboard - totally mouse-only (L454-462). 'Reset Zoom' is a clickable div, not a button (L513-519). SVG has no title/role. Wheel handler calls preventDefault inside a React (passive) wheel listener, which does not prevent page scroll and logs warnings (L241-248).
api: React.FC, no forwardRef/rest/style. onNodeAdd and onNodeDelete are declared but never invoked (L56-58, L79-80). showMinimap draws dots with a fixed /3 transform unrelated to the viewBox (L533-539). useMindMap hook is a reasonable but separate state helper.
ssr: 'use client'; document listeners only in effects; safe.
fake_complexity: Drag is broken: handleMouseMove adds cumulative delta from drag start to the node's already-updated position, so nodes accelerate away from the cursor (L215-233). Node mousedown also bubbles to the pan handler so drag and pan fire together (L459 vs L550). Edges use fixed +50/+25 offsets regardless of node size/shape (L321-324). Custom connections that duplicate parent-child edges produce duplicate React keys (L351-369). ReactNode icons placed inside <tspan> are invalid SVG for non-strings (L471-475).
duplicates: workflow/diagram canvases elsewhere in library (node graph style components)
target: Remove from root; if a diagram surface is wanted, rebuild on a real graph lib (React Flow) adapter with glass node skins
justification: The interactive features it advertises (drag, add/delete, minimap) are broken or unwired, it is mouse-only with zero keyboard access, and its palette is hard-coded dark rgba. The certification screenshot shows a small cluster of nodes in a mostly empty pale frame. Building a correct mind-map is a product in itself; deprecate and point to a glass-skinned adapter over an established graph engine.

name: GlassPatternBuilder
material_impl: Nested OptimizedGlass panels (tool, layer, template) with redundant duplicated classes ('glass-contrast-guard' twice, glass-backdrop-blur-md on top of OptimizedGlass blur) (L747, L845, L924). Default palette hard-coded hex (L115-123), ruler text '#333' (L686). Canvas fillStyle/strokeStyle are set to CSS strings 'var(--glass-white)', 'var(--glass-black)', 'rgba(var(--glass-color-black) / var(--glass-opacity-10))', 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' which Canvas2D cannot parse - they are silently ignored and default to black.
motion: Motion fadeIn gated by isMotionSafe. requestAnimationFrame loop (L717-725) is never cancelled and a new loop is started every time render() identity changes (any state change), so loops multiply unbounded and keep running after unmount. With reduced motion it just renders once - inverted priorities (reduced-motion users get correct perf, everyone else gets leaking loops).
a11y: Canvas has no role/label/keyboard alternative. Layer rows are clickable divs (L859-867). Emoji-only eye/trash buttons have aria-labels (good). Colour swatches labelled 'Select color N' without colour name.
api: forwardRef, className + rest passthrough. Props layers/activeLayerIndex/selectedElements/zoom are only initial values (controlled props ignored after mount). handleMouseMove is an empty stub (L350-358) - size-by-drag not implemented. SVG export ignores triangle/line (L536). generateSVG used before defined inside exportPattern closure deps.
ssr: 'use client'; canvas access in effects; safe. Fixed 800x600 canvas inline width/height -> overflows mobile.
fake_complexity: High. 'Pattern builder' with layers/templates/export but: drawing is click-to-stamp only, drag is a stub, canvas background renders BLACK because fillStyle 'var(--glass-white)' is invalid (screenshot ASCII analysis shows a solid near-black 800x600 block filling the layout; desktop mean luminance 171 vs ~244 for neighbours), undo history is partially wired (visibility toggle bypasses history).
justification: Not exported from any entry point, so it is dead weight with nine stories advertising it. It renders a black canvas due to CSS-var-in-canvas bugs, leaks compounding rAF loops, has a stubbed drag path, a fixed 800px canvas and is outside a design system's remit. Delete it and its stories/tests/snapshots.
evidence: rg: no import of GlassPatternBuilder outside its own files/types.ts

name: GlassPresets (+ Clean/Frosted/Textured/Subtle/Standard/Immersive/Dashboard/Form/ModalGlassContainer)
material_impl: Thin wrappers over ContextAwareGlass (interactive/ContextAwareGlass.tsx, 674 lines) setting numeric baseBlurStrength/baseOpacity/baseBorderOpacity per preset - i.e. the token system is bypassed with magic numbers per wrapper. Immersive default glowColor '#6366F1' hard-coded, which also makes the 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' fallback dead code (L231, L246). TexturedGlassContainer noise data-URI is malformed ("xmlns='http:, //www.w3.org/2000/svg'" L120) so the SVG fails to parse and no noise renders.
a11y: Pure containers; no semantics. Not applicable beyond passthrough.
api: forwardRef everywhere, rest passthrough; nine near-identical wrappers + a switch component. useGlassTheme called and 'theme' unused in two wrappers (L235, L342). data-glass-component only on Clean variant.
fake_complexity: 'Textured' preset does nothing visible (broken data URI). Certification Default story renders no visible content at all: DOM textLength 52 = only skip links; screenshot luminance range 234-255 (blank).
duplicates: OptimizedGlass intent/elevation/intensity props (the real preset system)
target: Express presets as token-level recipes on OptimizedGlass (intent/elevation) instead of wrapper components
justification: Unexported, visually blank in certification, duplicated by the OptimizedGlass elevation/intensity API, and its one distinctive preset (textured noise) is broken by a typo. Presets belong in tokens/recipes, not nine wrapper components with magic numbers.
evidence: rg: GlassPresets not referenced by src/index.ts or any package subpath

name: GlassQueryBuilder
material_impl: Bespoke group surface via utilities 'glass-border-white/25 glass-bg-white/10 glass-backdrop-blur-md' and forced 'glass-text-white' (L164, L234) - white text hard-coded, illegible on light themes. Uses compound GlassSelect for fields/ops (good reuse). Raw <input> styled with glass-bg-white/10 glass-text-white.
a11y: role=group + aria-label on root, aria-labels on select triggers (good). Value <input> has no label (L139-146). Remove buttons say 'Remove' without context. Groups not announced as nested groups.
api: Function component, no forwardRef/rest. Mutates the caller's value object in place (rule.field = v; parent.rules.splice(...); group.rules.push(...)) then emits a shallow copy (L62, L75, L152, L188, L198) - breaks React immutability and memoised consumers. Uncontrolled use is impossible: default value is a fresh literal each render and there is no internal state, so without a controlled value the UI never updates. Crashes when fields=[] (fields[0].id L188, field.type of undefined L114). Index keys (L69, L222). Operator list fixed regardless of field type.
fake_complexity: No; real recursive builder, but structurally unsound state handling.
target: Immutable reducer-based QueryBuilder with typed operators per field type, controlled+uncontrolled support, and theme tokens instead of glass-text-white
justification: A query builder is genuinely useful for dashboard/workflow consumers and it already reuses GlassSelect, but in-place mutation of props, crash on empty fields, non-functional uncontrolled mode and hard-coded white text make it unsafe to ship. Keep the concept, rewrite the state model and theming.

name: GlassReactionBar
material_impl: No material of its own; row of GlassButton variant=ghost. Imports cn from '@/lib/utils' but never uses it (L2) while sibling files import from utilsComprehensive - two cn sources.
motion: Inherits GlassButton press states only. No count-change animation.
a11y: Buttons have visible emoji + count but no aria-pressed for 'reacted by me', no aria-label ('thumbs up, 12 reactions'). Screen readers read raw emoji then number.
api: No forwardRef/rest. No selected/own-reaction state, no add-reaction affordance, reactions mapped as any.
target: GlassReactions (advanced/GlassReactions.tsx) as the single reactions component with a 'bar' variant
justification: Three root-exported reaction components is noise. This one is the thinnest - a map over ghost buttons without pressed state or accessible labels. Merge into one reactions API (bar/bubbles variants, aria-pressed, accessible names) and drop this export.

name: GlassSearchInterface
material_impl: Reuses GlassInput, GlassButton, GlassBadge, OptimizedGlass(level2) for dropdown with extra 'glass-surface-dark/30' overlay (stacked tints). Search icons are inline hand-drawn SVG paths repeated four times instead of the library icon set (L451-463, L528-540, L566-578, L670-682).
motion: Motion preset slideDown for dropdown, not reduced-motion gated at call site (relies on Motion primitive). Spinner glass-animate-spin.
a11y: Not a combobox: no role=combobox/listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls or aria-activedescendant; arrow-key focus is a visual class only. Critically, the dropdown is wrapped in FocusTrap (autoFocus defaults true, primitives/focus/FocusTrap.tsx:62) which opens on input focus and moves focus into the first suggestion button - stealing focus from the input as the user starts typing (L447, L491, L507). Filter-count badge is a clickable span with no keyboard support, absolutely positioned -right-12 outside the input (L477-486).
api: forwardRef + rest. value only seeds internal state (no sync on prop change, L204). Ships package-owned demo content (fake 'Components 126 / Patterns 34', fake results) whenever no data props are passed (L39-71, L211-233) - production consumers in an empty/loading state see fake data. Debounce timer not cleared on unmount. variant classes are all identical 'glass-w-full' (L379-384).
fake_complexity: Demo data injection is a production-facing fake (certification DOM sample shows 'AllComponents126Patterns34' with no consumer data).
target: GlassCommandPalette / GlassCombobox core (single search+listbox engine), with filters as a separate facet panel
justification: The focus trap makes the search box unusable for typing, it lacks combobox semantics, and it silently renders fake catalog data in production. The library already has CommandPalette, SpotlightSearch and Combobox; merge into one accessible search/listbox engine and migrate GlassListView.
evidence: screenshot desktop.png: luminance min 196, only faint category pills visible

name: GlassSignaturePad
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell; canvas forced 'bg-white' (raw Tailwind) inside glass; buttons wrap an OptimizedGlass inside a <button> (double surface, L414-435). Pen colour default 'var(--glass-black)' is invalid in Canvas2D (falls back to black by accident, L114). Placeholder colour hard-coded rgba(156,163,175,0.5).
motion: useMotionPreference-gated fadeIn; scale hover on buttons not gated. Unused useReducedMotion import (L10).
a11y: Canvas role=application with label + sr-only instructions (decent). No keyboard alternative (typed signature) - WCAG 2.1.1 failure for a required form input. Disabled uses pointer-events-none on the whole root.
api: forwardRef + rest. Controlled 'value' re-runs the init effect which resets canvas.width (clearing) on every onChange round-trip (L122-160). Placeholder 'Sign here' is painted INTO the canvas bitmap and never erased when drawing starts, so it is baked into the exported signature image (L338-358). No devicePixelRatio scaling - blurry on retina. Fixed width=400 inline -> overflows 390px mobile. exportFormat 'svg' calls toDataURL('image/svg') which browsers do not support (silently PNG). pressure captured but unused. No pointer capture -> stroke ends when leaving canvas.
fake_complexity: Velocity-based width is real but primitive; 'svg export' is fake.
target: If needed for forms, rebuild on signature_pad (MIT) with DPR scaling, pointer capture, typed-signature fallback and form value integration; otherwise drop
justification: Not exported, so no consumer depends on it. The placeholder is baked into exported images, controlled mode wipes the canvas, it is blurry on HiDPI and overflows mobile. A signature field is a legitimate form primitive but this one is not salvageable as-is.
evidence: src/components/interactive/GlassSignaturePad.tsx:122-160 (init effect depends on value, resets canvas)
rg: not exported from src/index.ts or subpaths

name: GlassSpotlight
material_impl: Fully bespoke inline material: backdropFilter 'blur(24px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.04) contrast(1.02)', white rgba gradients, rgba borders and box-shadows (L115-127, L64-84) - no OptimizedGlass/tokens. Light-only white tints; cutout uses 9999px box-shadow trick with rgba(15,23,42,0.24).
motion: Two competing animation systems for the demo orb: JS rAF loop updating React state every frame (setDemoPhase, L89-99) AND a CSS keyframe animation on the same element (L159-166); inline transform from rAF overrides the keyframe. CSS honours prefers-reduced-motion; JS honours useReducedMotion. Re-renders the whole component 60fps while demoMotion.
a11y: Root div onClick={onClose} with no role=dialog, no Escape handling, no focus management, no aria-modal; the 'hole' is decorative. Emits sr-only 'Glass spotlight inactive' text when no target (noise). Full-screen fixed overlay without inert background.
api: forwardRef + rest + style merge (good). targetRect is a DOMRect snapshot - no element ref/anchor tracking on scroll/resize. contained/preview aliases. Injects a <style> tag per instance.
ssr: 'use client'; performance.now in effect only; safe.
fake_complexity: demoMotion is a package-owned demo animation shipped in the production component.
duplicates: GlassSpotlightSearch (search/) shares name, different purpose (naming collision)
target: Tour/Coachmark built on primitives/dismissable-layer + positioning, anchor-element based, tokenised scrim material
justification: Spotlight/coachmarks are a premium-feel pattern and this is one of the more visually considered files (highest contrast in its screenshot), but it is bespoke CSS outside the material system, has no dialog semantics or focus handling, uses static DOMRects and runs a 60fps React state loop for a demo orb. Rebuild on the existing overlay primitives.

name: GlassStepper (interactive)

tests.kind: templated; also src/components/input/GlassStepper.test.tsx for the other stepper

material_impl: Pills use 'ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-glass-fill' (non-prefixed Tailwind mixed with glass-*), connector glass-surface-subtle/15. No OptimizedGlass. Dynamic Tailwind class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms]` built at runtime (L58) - will not be generated by a JIT/static extractor.
motion: glass-hover--translate-y, glass-press, glass-ripple, glass-pulse-ring utilities; pulse logic is broken: lastActiveRef is updated in an effect after render, so wasJustActivated is true on every render where active differs from the previous commit, including the first mount (L33-50). No reduced-motion handling in component (depends on CSS utilities).
a11y: Buttons with aria-current='step' and aria-label (good). No completed/upcoming state, no step numbers, optional flag in Step type is never rendered (L9). Not wrapped in nav/ol.
api: Extends HTMLAttributes, rest passthrough, no forwardRef. Defaults to fake 'Step 1/2/3' data when steps missing. Name collides with src/components/input/GlassStepper.tsx (589 lines) - two different components named GlassStepper, root exports this thinner one.
fake_complexity: None, but it is a pill row, not a stepper (no progress/completion semantics).
target: src/components/input/GlassStepper.tsx / GlassFormStepper - one Stepper with completed/active/upcoming states
justification: Three steppers exist, two share the exact name, and the root exports the weakest one (no completion state, unused optional flag, runtime-built Tailwind class, misfiring pulse). Consolidate into a single Stepper API and remove this file.

name: GlassTagInput
material_impl: OptimizedGlass then overrides it with inline style background 'var(--glass-primary-level3-surface)', border '1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.2)' and bespoke boxShadow rgba values (L41-47) - double border (class glass-border-white/10 + inline). Screenshot: input is a faint pale band; darkest text pixels only 0.04% of frame.
a11y: Remove '×' buttons have no aria-label ('×' read as 'times') (L55-60), no type='button'. Input has no label/aria-label - placeholder only (L63-76). Suggestions are not a listbox, not keyboard navigable (Arrow keys), not announced. Chips not a list.
api: Controlled-only (value default [] with no internal state - typing Enter in uncontrolled use does nothing visible since onChange defaults to noop). No forwardRef, no input ref, no rest. Default param value=[] creates new array each render. No max tags, validation, paste-splitting, or delimiter config.
justification: Tag input is a common need, but this version overrides the shared material with inline rgba, has unlabelled controls, mouse-only suggestions and is controlled-only. GlassMultiSelect/Combobox already cover chips+listbox; add a 'creatable' mode there and retire this export.

name: GlassThemeDemo
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell (tier high), composes ~20 library components. Compact swatches are hard-coded hex '#f8fafc', '#cbd5e1', '#64748b' (L138) - not the active theme. Embeds CursorGlow overlay.
motion: hover:scale-[1.02] on cards gated by useReducedMotion; CursorGlow (pointer-tracking) not gated here.
a11y: Many nested h2 'Typography' headings inside cards under h1; Slider has both aria-label and aria-labelledby; inherits sub-component a11y.
api: forwardRef + rest. showCode prints MUI-style snippets that do not match this library's API (variant='contained'/'outlined'/'text', severity=, Paper, TabPanel, Divider) (L191-193, L333-336, L450-454, L516-520) - actively misleading docs. 'Performance Metrics' section is a placeholder sentence (L736-749). Passes themes={[]} to GlassThemeSwitcher. activeTab state unused. Same 'Card' rendered as 'Paper Card'.
ssr: 'use client'; heavy: imports 20+ components into one root export.
fake_complexity: High: it is a docs page shipped as a component; 'performance metrics' and code snippets are fake.
target: Move to Storybook/docs site as an MDX showcase page
justification: A demo page has no place in the package's public API and inflates bundle/import graph. Its code samples document a different library (MUI), and its metrics panel is placeholder text. Move the showcase into docs, rewrite snippets against the real API, and drop the export.

name: GlassThemeSwitcher
material_impl: GlassCard shell; option tiles use non-prefixed 'ring-primary bg-primary/20 ring-white/10 bg-white/5' (L262-265). Preview colours hard-coded hex (#64748b, #0f172a, #94a3b8, #cbd5e1, #f8fafc, #1e293b) rather than reading actual theme tokens (L111-149).
motion: Motion fadeIn/scaleIn presets per tile, hover:scale-[1.02] not reduced-motion gated in component.
a11y: Theme tiles are Motion divs with onClick - not buttons/radios, no tabIndex, no keyboard, no role=radiogroup/aria-checked (L254-267, L333-346). Settings icon button has no aria-label (L225-232). Colour text inputs have no label association (L403-427: visible <label> not linked).
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. currentTheme only seeds state (no controlled sync). 'themes' typed required but defaulted. Does not integrate with the library's ThemeProvider/useGlassTheme - it only fires onThemeChange; selecting 'Dark' changes nothing by itself. 'System' option does no prefers-color-scheme detection despite enableSystemTheme prop.
fake_complexity: Yes: presents as a theme switcher but switches nothing and 'System' detection is fake.
target: ThemeSwitcher bound to the theme subpath provider (useGlassTheme), segmented-control/radiogroup semantics, real system detection
justification: A theme switcher is a core design-system piece, but this one is a mouse-only grid of divs with hard-coded preview colours that does not actually change the theme or detect system preference. Rebuild as a radiogroup/segmented control wired to the real theme provider.

name: GlassUserPresence
material_impl: GlassCard shell; status uses raw Tailwind bg-green-400/yellow-400/red-400/gray-400 and text-green-400 etc (L122-161), avatar ring 'border-2 border-black' hard-coded (L302, L568) - black ring breaks on dark glass and is off-token.
motion: Motion fadeIn on card and every row; not reduced-motion gated at call site.
a11y: Status conveyed by colour dot only in compact mode (WCAG 1.4.1). Rows are Motion divs with onClick, no keyboard (L531-537). Status-setter buttons have aria-labels but online/busy/invisible all use the same Circle icon (L127, L143, L149) - visually indistinguishable apart from variant. 'More options' button is a no-op.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef; ...props spread onto GlassCard though props type has no HTML attrs. getStatusConfig, getRoleBadge and formatLastSeen are duplicated verbatim inside UserPresenceItem (L446-528) and the outer copies of getRoleBadge/formatLastSeen are unused. groupByStatus ignores maxUsers. 'glass-gap-2' applied to non-flex divs (no effect) and typo class 'glass-min-glass-w-0' (L576). Hard-coded title 'Team Presence'.
ssr: 'use client'; formatLastSeen uses new Date() in render (hydration mismatch risk).
target: GlassPresenceIndicator + GlassAvatar(status) composed into a PresenceList recipe
justification: Three presence components exist; this one duplicates its own helpers, uses raw Tailwind status colours and a hard-coded black avatar ring, and has typo'd/no-op classes. Fold the useful parts (list grouping, status setter) into a PresenceList built on GlassAvatar status and GlassPresenceIndicator tokens.

name: GlassVideoPlayer
material_impl: GlassCard shell with glass-surface-dark video area, gradient scrim utilities, GlassButton controls, GlassBadge title. Reasonable reuse; no bespoke blur.
motion: Fade preset; controls auto-hide after 3s via timeout; no reduced-motion relevance beyond Motion.
a11y: Icon buttons have aria-labels (good). Seek bar is a clickable div: no role=slider, no keyboard, no aria-valuenow (L524-534). Volume bar is display-only, not adjustable (L572-577). Global document keydown handler hijacks Space/Arrows/M/F for the entire page - typing a space or 'f' in any input elsewhere toggles playback/fullscreen, and multiple players all react (L235-282). Controls hidden by timeout also hide from keyboard users.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. enablePiP declared, never used (L64, L114). Settings button toggles showSettings but no settings panel is ever rendered (L141, L468-476). currentQuality/playbackSpeed state never changeable; playbackSpeeds prop unused. Fullscreen state not synced to fullscreenchange events (Esc exit leaves isFullscreen true).
ssr: 'use client'; document access in effects/handlers only.
fake_complexity: Yes: PiP, settings, quality and speed selection are advertised but unimplemented. Certification DOM shows '0:00 / 0:00' and fallback text 'Your browser does not support the video tag' - the story never loaded a playable video.
target: GlassAdvancedVideoPlayer (media/) - single player, after fixing scoped keyboard shortcuts and slider semantics
justification: Two root-exported video players; this one has dead settings/PiP features, a non-accessible seek bar and a page-wide keyboard hijack that breaks any form on the same page. Merge into the media player, scope shortcuts to the focused player, and use a real slider for seek/volume.

name: GlassVirtualList (+ GlassVirtualGrid)
material_impl: No glass material at all - plain overflow div (only the loading pill uses glass utilities). 'Glass' prefix is cosmetic. GlassVirtualGrid is exported from the module but not from root.
motion: Motion fadeIn wrapper; 'scroll-smooth' class on by default (smoothScroll=true) not reduced-motion gated.
a11y: No role=list/listitem, no aria-setsize/aria-posinset for virtualised items, no keyboard scroll-to-index. Loading pill has no aria-live.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no scrollToIndex/imperative handle. Unusual item API: each item must carry a React component + props (component: ElementType) instead of renderItem(index). Variable-height mode is incorrect: visibleRange divides scrollTop by estimatedItemHeight while offsetY sums real heights, so the rendered window drifts from the viewport (L104-142). O(n) offset loop per scroll. onEndReached fires on every scroll event within threshold (no guard) (L152-157). GlassVirtualGrid: rowHeight is 0 until containerWidth measured -> divide-by-zero range on first render; window resize only (no ResizeObserver). Loading pill uses odd class 'glass--left-1-2' (L222).
ssr: 'use client'; window listener in effect; safe.
fake_complexity: Partially: 'dynamic sizing' is claimed but not implemented correctly.
target: @tanstack/react-virtual behind the existing useVirtualization hook; expose renderItem API and reuse in GlassVirtualTable/MessageList
justification: Virtualisation is infrastructure, not a visual component, and this hand-rolled version is wrong for variable heights, spams onEndReached and has no a11y semantics. Replace the engine with a proven virtualizer behind useVirtualization, and keep a thin glass-styled list wrapper only if needed.

name: GlassVoiceInput
material_impl: Nested OptimizedGlass panels with duplicated classes (glass-contrast-guard twice) plus raw Tailwind bg-red-500/20, text-red-400, bg-green-500 etc (L683-684, L805). Canvas gradient stops use 'color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--glass-color-info)) ...)' strings (L535-546, L618) - Canvas2D cannot resolve CSS vars, addColorStop throws SyntaxError, so the visualizer throws inside rAF as soon as audio is non-zero. Imports ContrastGuard and useReducedMotion but never uses them.
motion: Visualizer rAF loop (L634-644) is never cancelled and depends on renderVisualizer, which changes on every audioData update (every frame) - so a new uncancelled loop is spawned every frame while listening: exponential rAF growth. Reduced-motion disables the visualizer (good intent). Audio analysis loop setState per frame (setAudioLevel, setFrequency, setAudioData).
